page.title: Family Boat Day in Cabopino: Paddleboarding Fun 2038

data.meta_description: Plan a family boat day in Cabopino with paddleboarding fun in 2038. Rent a boat from Puerto Banús for 2–8 hours, with skipper and snacks included.
data.summary: Discover how to combine a family boat rental in Marbella with paddleboarding in Cabopino. Our guide covers boat options, pricing, and tips for a fun day on the water.
key_facts: Cabopino is a peaceful cove 15 minutes east of Puerto Banús, ideal for paddleboarding.
Family-friendly boats include the Dubhe (5 pax, €749/2h) and Astondoa 40 (9 pax, €749/2h).
All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.
Paddleboards can be brought aboard or rented locally at Cabopino beach.
Best months for calm waters and paddleboarding are May–October.
Departure from Puerto Banús; Cabopino is a 20–30 minute cruise.

faq.q: Can I bring my own paddleboard on a boat rental?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring your own paddleboard. Most boats have deck space to store an inflatable paddleboard. We recommend deflating it before boarding and inflating at Cabopino. If you don’t have one, you can rent paddleboards at Cabopino beach for around €15–20 per hour.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a family with small children?
faq.a: The Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is a compact, stable boat ideal for small families. For larger groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) offers more space and a shaded cockpit. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper.

faq.q: How long does it take to get from Puerto Banús to Cabopino?
faq.a: The cruise from Puerto Banús to Cabopino takes about 20–30 minutes, depending on sea conditions and speed. It’s a short, scenic ride along the coast past Marbella’s Golden Mile.

faq.q: Is paddleboarding safe for children in Cabopino?
faq.a: Cabopino has calm, shallow waters, making it safe for children to paddleboard under adult supervision. The beach is sheltered, and there are no strong currents. Life jackets are available on all our boats.

faq.q: What is included in the boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

faq.q: Can I extend my rental if we want to stay longer at Cabopino?
faq.a: Yes, you can extend your rental on the day subject to availability. Contact us via WhatsApp to check. Standard durations are 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance for a family boat day in 2038?
faq.a: We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially during summer (June–August) and for weekends. Early booking ensures you get your preferred boat and time slot.

faq.q: What other activities can we do near Cabopino?
faq.a: Besides paddleboarding, Cabopino has a sandy beach, a small marina with restaurants, and the Cabopino dunes nature reserve. You can also anchor for swimming, snorkelling, or simply relaxing.

data.body_html:
If you’re looking for a relaxed family day on the water, combining a boat rental with paddleboarding in Cabopino is a winning formula. Cabopino, a quiet cove just east of Marbella, offers calm, shallow waters perfect for paddleboarding, especially for children. In 2038, the trend for active, family-friendly sea days continues to grow, and our fleet from Puerto Banús makes it easy to pack a paddleboard and head out for 2 to 8 hours. Here’s everything you need to know to plan your [family boat day in Cabopino with paddleboarding](/blog/cabopino-boat-rental-family-day-paddleboarding-2038/).

Why Cabopino for a Family Boat Day?

Cabopino is one of the Costa del Sol’s hidden gems. Unlike the busier beaches of Marbella or Puerto Banús, Cabopino’s waters are calm and sheltered, with minimal boat traffic. The beach is backed by protected sand dunes, giving it a natural feel. Water temperatures in summer hover around 22–26°C, ideal for paddleboarding. The cove is also close to the Cabopino marina, where you can grab lunch or ice cream after your paddle session.

Best Boats for a Family Day with Paddleboarding

Not all boats are created equal when you’re bringing paddleboards. Here are our top picks from the fleet, all departing Puerto Banús:

  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – compact, easy to handle, and perfect for a small family. Plenty of deck space for an inflatable paddleboard.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) – more space, a sunpad, and a shaded cockpit. Great for multi-generational groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, €749/2h) – similar size, with a spacious bow area for paddleboard storage.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – a fun, open option for a shorter trip; easy to load a paddleboard.

All boats come with a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. You just bring your paddleboard (or rent one at Cabopino).

Pricing for Your Family Boat Day

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, up to €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. That includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, with a free jet ski included. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. No hidden fees – what you see is what you pay.

What to Bring for Paddleboarding

If you own an inflatable paddleboard, we recommend deflating it before arrival and inflating it once you anchor at Cabopino. Our boats have 12V pumps available on request. Alternatively, you can rent a paddleboard at Cabopino beach (approx. €15–20/hour). Don’t forget: sunscreen, hats, towels, and a change of clothes. Life jackets are provided for all ages.

Sample Itinerary: 4-Hour Family Boat Day

10:00 – Depart Puerto Banús. Cruise east past Marbella’s Golden Mile and the Río Verde beach.
10:30 – Arrive at Cabopino. Anchor in the calm waters near the dune reserve.
10:45–12:30 – Paddleboarding, swimming, and snorkelling. The water is shallow and clear.
12:30–13:00 – Light lunch on board (snacks and drinks included).
13:00–13:30 – Cruise back to Puerto Banús.
13:30 – Disembark.

This 4-hour trip costs €1,149 for a Tier A boat – a full day of family fun without the rush.

Other Family-Friendly Destinations Near Cabopino

If you want to extend your day, you can also visit Cala del Faro (a small cove west of Marbella) or Cala Cortés (near Estepona). Both offer calm waters and paddleboarding opportunities. Alternatively, head to Sotogrande for a more exclusive marina experience. Our skippers know the best spots and can tailor the route to your family’s preferences.

Book Your Family Boat Day in Cabopino for 2038

Ready to plan your family boat day in Cabopino with paddleboarding? Browse our full fleet and book online. For questions or custom requests, contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking 2–3 weeks ahead for summer dates. Your adventure on the water starts here: [book your boat](/).
